verdict.rationale: Muse lets users inspect, edit and download files stored in their VM, which is some evidence of data portability, but there is no mention of a full account-data export, open/standard export formats, or a clean way to fully leave the platform with all associated data (goals, chat history, connectors, memory). missing for 10: documented full-account export feature, open/standard file formats for exported data, explicit account deletion/data portability workflow, independent confirmation that exported data is usable outside Muse.
